title: Weatherglass

adaptations: Explicit scene creation and destruction for Vue lifecycle
Original imperative HUD replaced by Vue single-file components
Scoped event listeners and frame subscriptions
Exposes the celestial sphere for geographic sun and moon placement

rendering: Original procedural geometry, shaders, simulation, pointer tools and audio are retained.

reality_driver.description: Optional real weather, local calendar and astronomical position/phase adapter; manual simulation remains available.
